label: Week 39, 2026
recap:
The week was modest, with 9 bill movements and 7 case updates recorded, and no federal documents. California accounted for 7 of the bill movements, while the District of Columbia and the United States Congress each accounted for 1. The shape of activity was narrow, with one state and one theme dominating.

Infrastructure and energy was the dominant theme, appearing in 7 records. Six other themes each appeared once: children and minors, employment and hiring, health care, privacy and data, transparency and disclosure, and workforce and education. No bills were left unthemed.
